domain_events_entity_check.name: domain_events_entity_check
domain_events_entity_check.value: ("domain_events"."entity_type" = 'note' and "domain_events"."note_id" is not null and "domain_events"."note_id" = "domain_events"."entity_id" and "domain_events"."person_id" is null) or ("domain_events"."entity_type" = 'person' and "domain_events"."person_id" is not null and "domain_events"."person_id" = "domain_events"."entity_id" and "domain_events"."note_id" is null)

summary_inference_reservations_settlemen.name: summary_inference_reservations_settlement
summary_inference_reservations_settlemen.value:
(
        "summary_inference_reservations"."settled_at" is null and "summary_inference_reservations"."input_tokens" is null
        and "summary_inference_reservations"."output_tokens" is null and "summary_inference_reservations"."actual_micro_usd" is null
      ) or (
        "summary_inference_reservations"."settled_at" is not null and "summary_inference_reservations"."input_tokens" is not null
        and "summary_inference_reservations"."output_tokens" is not null and "summary_inference_reservations"."actual_micro_usd" is not null
        and "summary_inference_reservations"."input_tokens" >= 0 and "summary_inference_reservations"."output_tokens" >= 0 and "summary_inference_reservations"."actual_micro_usd" >= 0
      )

transcript_segments_assignment.name: transcript_segments_assignment
transcript_segments_assignment.value: ("transcript_segments"."assignment_kind" = 'unassigned' and "transcript_segments"."assignment_source" = 'unassigned' and "transcript_segments"."person_id" is null) or ("transcript_segments"."assignment_kind" = 'unknown' and "transcript_segments"."assignment_source" = 'manual' and "transcript_segments"."person_id" is null) or ("transcript_segments"."assignment_kind" = 'person' and "transcript_segments"."assignment_source" = 'manual' and "transcript_segments"."person_id" is not null)

conversation_summary_jobs_coverage.name: conversation_summary_jobs_coverage
conversation_summary_jobs_coverage.value:
"conversation_summary_jobs"."from_sequence" > 0 and "conversation_summary_jobs"."through_sequence" >= "conversation_summary_jobs"."from_sequence"
        and "conversation_summary_jobs"."message_count" between 1 and 50
        and "conversation_summary_jobs"."message_count" <= "conversation_summary_jobs"."through_sequence" - "conversation_summary_jobs"."from_sequence" + 1
        and jsonb_array_length("conversation_summary_jobs"."messages") = "conversation_summary_jobs"."message_count"
        and jsonb_array_length("conversation_summary_jobs"."sources") = "conversation_summary_jobs"."message_count"

inference_receipts_settlement.name: inference_receipts_settlement
inference_receipts_settlement.value:
(
        "inference_receipts"."settled_at" is null and "inference_receipts"."input_tokens" is null
        and "inference_receipts"."output_tokens" is null and "inference_receipts"."actual_micro_usd" is null
      ) or (
        "inference_receipts"."settled_at" is not null and "inference_receipts"."input_tokens" is not null
        and "inference_receipts"."output_tokens" is not null and "inference_receipts"."actual_micro_usd" is not null
        and "inference_receipts"."input_tokens" >= 0 and "inference_receipts"."output_tokens" >= 0
        and "inference_receipts"."actual_micro_usd" between 0 and 9007199254740991
      )
